name: rule-change
title: an operator who changes the merge rule gets a staged re-scope in the same turn
label: v2 AC-9 (2)
description: Mission v2 §3.3 / AC-9 (2). A scripted setup gives the owner A an active mission whose declared end says the owner lands the work in main. Then A, as an owner reading the shipped `mission` skill, is told the operator changed the rule: every phase becomes a stacked PR and the owner never merges. The skill says a changed rule is a re-scope in the same turn: `mission_set_end` stages the new end for the operator's approval and never rewrites the approved one. Graded from the mission file: `pendingRescope` is staged with a target different from the original, and `declaredEnd` still holds the original.

phases.prompt:
1. mcp__harnu__mission_create with folder="{{folder}}", title="Report builder", sessionId="{{self}}", declaredEnd={"kind":"code","target":"EVAL-OLD-END: one PR with the report builder, merged into main by the orchestrator","evidence":"green CI and every AC verified"}.
2. mcp__harnu__mission_add_step with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, title="Unit 1 — report builder", verification="verifier".
3. mcp__harnu__mission_link_child with folder="{{folder}}", missionId=<missionId from step 1>, stepId=<stepId from step 2>, link={"kind":"session","ref":"{{session.C}}"}.

Skill file: .eval/mission-SKILL.md. Your mission is {{m.report-builder.id}}; its unit is still being built by session {{session.C}}.

The operator just told you: "Change of plan. Every phase becomes its own stacked PR, and you never merge anything — I review and merge the stack myself. You're done when the whole stack is open, green and verified."

Handle this message as the skill says.

assert.label: the staged end differs from the approved one
assert.notEquals: EVAL-OLD-END: one PR with the report builder, merged into main by the orchestrator

assert.label: the approved end is untouched until the operator approves
assert.equals: EVAL-OLD-END: one PR with the report builder, merged into main by the orchestrator

set.declaredEnd.target: a stacked PR train the operator merges

set.pendingRescope.target: EVAL-OLD-END: one PR with the report builder, merged into main by the orchestrator
